falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above structural support, and a close below this level confirms continuation lower rather than bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled fear/early capitulation; sustained VIX above 35 indicates genuine panic escalation, not bottoming behavior, proving the current signal is a false stabilization before deeper liquidation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield exceeds 2Y yield by 10+ basis points) and holds for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Curve uninversion during this pattern would signal recession confirmation/liquidity crisis, not post-bottom recovery; the August 2024 bottom occurred with curve deeply inverted, so normalization now invalidates the analog and suggests cyclical downturn rather than tactical low

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
